The plate spans about 340 px in the photo. If it is a 26 cm dinner plate, that is roughly 13 px per cm.

The food covers an area about 190 px wide by 300 px tall, or roughly 14 cm by 20 cm at an irregular shape. That is about 150 cm² of coverage.

It looks like hash browns or shredded potato topped with salsa verde and pico de gallo. The layer is thin, about 1.5 cm thick, so the volume is around 200 cm³. Shredded potato is airy, so the mass is probably about 150 g, with 40 g of salsa on top for about 190 g in total.

Hash browns that have been fried run about 1.6 kcal/g, so 150 g gives about 240 kcal. The salsa adds roughly 20 kcal. The total comes to about 260 kcal, and I'll round up to 270 to allow for some oil.
